rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when a person, action, or thing is unwelcome.

example.english: This salesperson is unwanted in front of the family.
example.traditional: 呢個推銷員喺屋企人面前唔受歡迎。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 teoi1 siu1 jyun4 hai2 uk1 kei2 jan4 min6 cin4 m4 sau6 fun1 jing4

rows.note: Use this when the speaker simply does not want the thing, rather than when it is socially unwelcome.

example.english: These old clothes are unwanted by me.
example.traditional: 呢啲舊衫係我唔想要嘅。
example.jyutping: ni1 di1 gau6 saam1 hai6 ngo5 m4 soeng2 jiu3 ge3
